line: Crowley on the Three of Wands, the card for the second decan of Aries (pdf p176, p187).

sections.title: The Three of Wands: title and attribution
sections.line: The title and the attribution of the Three of Wands, pdf p176, p187.

quotes.quote: The Three of Wands is accordingly the Lord of Virtue.
It refers to the Sun in Aries, the Sign in which he is exalted.

sections.title: Crowley's description of the card
sections.line: Crowley's description of the Three of Wands, pdf p187.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Binah in the suit of Fire, and so represents the establishment of primeval Energy.
